title: stripe-billing-invoices.html
content: An {{variable.Object_Invoice}} states the amount a customer owes. {{variable.Object_Invoice}} s can be generated periodically from {{variable.Object_Subscription}} s or as a one-off {{variable.Object_Invoice}} . A {{variable.Feature_StripeInvoice}} is created from the Blackthorn {{variable.Object_Invoice}} (bt_stripe__Sales_Document__c) object. Types of Invoices There are two types of {{variable.Object_Invoice}} s created by the Blackthorn {{variable.Object_Invoice}} object: {{variable.Object_Invoice}} and {{variable.Feature_StripeInvoice}} . Invoices The checkout process generates {{variable.Object_Invoice}} s. Not all fields from a Blackthorn {{variable.Object_Invoice}} are mapped to a {{variable.Feature_StripeInvoice}} , and {{variable.Object_Invoice}} s can work independently from {{variable.Feature_StripeInvoice}} s. Stripe Invoices A {{variable.Feature_StripeInvoice}} is included with all records coming from {{variable.Component_StripeBilling}} . All fields on a {{variable.Feature_StripeInvoice}} are mapped to an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} . The following list includes the {{variable.Feature_StripeInvoice}} fields that are mapped to an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} : Name Customer (Mandatory) Subscription Stripe Coupon Stripe Invoice Id Stripe Hosted Invoice Link Currency Bill To Street Bill To Street 2 Bill To City Bill To State Bill To Country Bill To Postal Code Ship To Street Ship To Street 2 Ship To City Ship To State Ship To Country Ship To Postal Code Automatically Generated Invoices When a customer’s transaction is complete and the charge is successful, {{variable.Product_Stripe}} generates a {{variable.Feature_StripeInvoice}} , which is synced to {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} through a {{variable.Task_Webhook}} . NOTE: {{variable.Object_Invoice}} s are only generated automatically from {{variable.Component_StripeBilling}} . {{variable.Object_PaymentSchedule}} s cannot create {{variable.Object_Invoice}} s. One-Off Invoices You can create an individual {{variable.Feature_StripeInvoice}} for a customer. Add Line Items Before you push the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} to {{variable.Product_Stripe}} , you must add at least one {{variable.Object_LineItem}} (bt_stripe__Line_Item__c) to the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} . The {{variable.Object_LineItem}} (s) record will inherit one of the following record types. {{variable.Field_PTInvoice_RecordType}} = "Line Item" This is used for all non-Stripe {{variable.Object_LineItem}} s on an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} . {{variable.Field_PTInvoice_RecordType}} = "Stripe Line Item" This is used for {{variable.Feature_StripeInvoice}} s. The {{variable.Object_LineItem}} record(s) must include either a {{variable.Field_LineItem_UnitPrice}} and  {{variable.Field_LineItem_Quantity}} , OR a  {{variable.Field_LineItem_Price}}  and  {{variable.Field_LineItem_Product}} , before the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} can be pushed to {{variable.Product_Stripe}} . Create a One-Off Invoice Go to the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} you want to sync to {{variable.Product_Stripe}} . Confirm that the following fields contain a value. {{variable.Field_SBInvoice_Customer}} {{variable.Field_SBInvoice_Currency}} Confirm that the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} has at least one  {{variable.Object_LineItem}}  with the {{variable.Field_LineItem_Description}} and the {{variable.Field_LineItem_UnitPrice}}  and  {{variable.Field_LineItem_Quantity}}  fields populated. Check the {{variable.Field_SBInvoice_PushToStripe}}  checkbox. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Update Line Items You can update existing {{variable.Object_LineItem}} s when the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} {{variable.Field_Invoice_Status}} = "Draft." This will trigger updates to the {{variable.Feature_StripeInvoice}} . Log a Partial Payment as Non-Gateway If you receive a partial payment, such as a check, you can log it as non-gateway against an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} in {{variable.Product_Stripe}} by using the customer’s {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} {{variable.Field_PGC_AccountBalance}} field in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} . Before the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} is due, {{variable.Product_Stripe}} will automatically apply the amount from the customer's {{variable.Field_PGC_AccountBalance}} field. Webhooks will update the remaining balance on the customer record. A {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} {{variable.Object_Transaction}} record will be created once the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} is paid in full. If the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} remains partially paid, the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} ’s {{variable.Field_Invoice_BalanceDue}} field will reflect the remaining amount due, and the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} ’s {{variable.Field_Invoice_PaymentStatus}} will be set to "Unpaid." Steps Go to Setup. In the Quick Find box, enter and click "Payment Gateway Customer." Click the Page Layouts tab. Select the "Stripe Customer Layout." Drag and drop the  {{variable.Field_PGC_AccountBalance}}  field onto the page layout. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Open the {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} record and refresh the page. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon next to the {{variable.Field_PGC_AccountBalance}}  field. Enter the value of the paid {{variable.Object_Invoice}} amount. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . You will see the {{variable.Field_PGC_AccountBalance}} reflected in your {{variable.Product_Stripe}} dashboard. Open the {{variable.Feature_StripeInvoice}} to see the applied amount. Once the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} is paid, a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} will be created and logged against the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} . Mapping a Stripe Invoice Status to an Invoice Status The following table shows the mapping relationship between the {{variable.Feature_StripeInvoice}} statuses and the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} statuses: Stripe Invoice Status Invoice Status draft Draft open Sent paid Completed* uncollectible Rejected void Voided * {{variable.Object_Invoice}} s with {{variable.Field_PTInvoice_Status}} = "Completed" cannot be edited. Troubleshooting & FAQs Troubleshooting Review the following scenarios that may cause an error before syncing an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} with {{variable.Product_Stripe}} . Scenario Error Message The {{variable.Object_Invoice}} {{variable.Field_SBInvoice_Customer}} field is blank. To push an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} to {{variable.Product_Stripe}} , you must enter a value in the {{variable.Field_SBInvoice_Customer}} field. Modify the discount {{variable.Object_Code}} on an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} after the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} is pushed to {{variable.Product_Stripe}} The discount {{variable.Object_Code}} cannot be modified using the API. The {{variable.Field_PGC_PaymentGateway}} field on the {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} record is not defined. Add a Payment Gateway to the {{variable.Field_PGC_PaymentGateway}} field. {{variable.Object_Invoice}} {{variable.Field_Invoice_Status}} = "Draft" and {{variable.Field_Invoice_DueDate}} = "before today" The {{variable.Object_Invoice}} 's {{variable.Field_Invoice_DueDate}} must be in the future. {{variable.Object_Invoice}} {{variable.Field_Invoice_Status}} = "Draft", {{variable.Field_Subscrip_BillingMethod}} = "Send Invoice," and {{variable.Field_Subscrip_DaysUntilDue}} and {{variable.Field_Invoice_DueDate}} are blank If the {{variable.Field_Subscrip_BillingMethod}} is set to "Send Invoice," the {{variable.Field_Subscrip_DaysUntilDue}} field must contain a value. The {{variable.Object_Invoice}} 's {{variable.Field_Subscrip_BillingMethod}} is set to "Send Invoice," but {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} 's {{variable.Field_PGC_Email}} field is blank. To create an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} to send to a {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} , the {{variable.Field_PGC_Email}} field must have a valid email. The {{variable.Object_Invoice}} 's {{variable.Field_Subscrip_BillingMethod}} is set to "Charge Automatically," but the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} 's {{variable.Field_Invoice_PaymentMethod}} field is blank, not valid, or not verified. To create an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} that will be charged automatically, the {{variable.Field_Invoice_PaymentMethod}} field must have a payment method. Add a Payment Method or change the {{variable.Field_Subscrip_BillingMethod}} to "Send Invoice." Try to change the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} {{variable.Field_Invoice_Status}} when it is set to "Completed" or "Voided." The {{variable.Object_Invoice}} {{variable.Field_Invoice_Status}} field cannot be changed if it is set to "Completed" or "Voided." Try to update an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} when the {{variable.Field_Invoice_Status}} is set to anything BUT "Draft." An {{variable.Object_Invoice}} can only be updated when the {{variable.Field_Invoice_Status}} is set to "Draft." Add a {{variable.Object_LineItem}} to an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} when the {{variable.Field_Invoice_Status}} is set to anything but "Draft." {{variable.Object_LineItem}} s can only be added to an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} when the {{variable.Field_Invoice_Status}} is set to "Draft." FAQs Q: Can I create a custom record type? A: No, custom record types are currently not supported. Q: How will my coupon (discount {{variable.Object_Code}} ) be applied? A: Coupons ( {{variable.Object_Code}} {{variable.Field_Code_DiscountPercentage}} or {{variable.Field_Code_DiscountAmount}} ) applied to prorated {{variable.Object_Subscription}} s in {{variable.Product_Stripe}} will be applied only at the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} level, not at the prorated {{variable.Object_LineItem}} level. Q: What permissions does my Site Guest User need? A: A guest user must be assigned the Blackthorn | Payments (Site Guest User) permission set and custom permissions to have Read access to several standard objects, which are required to process the webhooks. The custom permission set must include the following object permissions: Account - Read Opportunity - Read Product2 – Read Q: How do I update the {{variable.Field_LineItem_Metadata}} field on a {{variable.Object_LineItem}} ? A: Add the {{variable.Field_LineItem_Metadata}} field to the {{variable.Object_LineItem}} ’s page layout. If a value is populated from this parameter, you will see the update in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} once the webhook process is complete.
